podcast.body: A classic Technopop album from 1981, the offer to perform this album in its entirety on tour was the catalyst for the band's reunion. "The original lineup had received some serious offers to perform their 1981 album, Architecture's and Morality in full on a tour."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 2

podcast.body: For their third album, the band acquired a Mellotron to achieve string and choir sounds, despite its antique and finicky nature. "I n our third-hour marketech from Alistair, we got a melatron because we wanted strings and choirs and things."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
